fields.Name: Elevate Report API
fields.Description: Elevate Report API authentication. Every read is a single POST to '{SiteUrl}/api/reports' with the api_key carried in the request BODY (never an Authorization header and never a URL parameter); the report is chosen by a body field and the columns by an explicit allow-list. SiteUrl is per-tenant - Elevate is hosted per organisation, so there is no shared default host.
